script:
set -uo pipefail
df -h /
task_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/codex-pr895-audit1708.XXXXXX) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf -- "$task_dir"' EXIT
tar -xzf - -C "$task_dir" || exit 1
cd "$task_dir" || exit 1
export PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH
bash scripts/hopper_ptx_gate_test.sh
result=$?
cd /tmp || exit 1
rm -rf -- "$task_dir"
trap - EXIT
df -h /
exit "$result"
